title: Taurus – Seismic Shifts Threaten Your Earth Element
script_text: Brace yourself, Taurus – seismic shifts threaten your Earth element this month! Saturn, Aquarius, squares your 10th House on July 12, demanding career overhaul and testing your goals. The relentless square forces you to rethink ambitions and rebuild your path. Venus slips into your 7th House on July 5, Mercury trine sparks dialogue and draws new love. Couples feel trust as Venus sextiles Moon, turning moments to romance. Jupiter enters 2nd House on July 18, swelling income, Saturn’s square to 6th House demands disciplined work. Balance spending, careful budgeting; effort wins the day. Mars moves in 12th House on July 9, fueling stamina; channel fire into meditation. Watch July 12 Saturn’s square, July 18 Jupiter’s entry, July 25 Sun on Ascendant, sparking confidence. Avoid impulsive spending when Venus conjoins Pluto on July 14 – emotions cloud judgment. Stay grounded, trust your Venusian intuition, stride into July with resolve.
